_metadata.description: DPMO FC Targets by Error Type, Curve Category, and Tenure (Day + Week)
_metadata.pct_to_target: % to DPMO Target = Target Errors / Actual Errors * 100

tenure_scales.day: Days 1-10: First ~80 hours. Day 1 = 0-14h, then +8h per day. Day 10 = ~72-80h. After day 10 → transitions to week 3.
tenure_scales.week: Weeks 3-10: After 80h. Week 3 = 81-120h, each week = +40h. Week 10 = 361-400h. Veterans (400h+) use week 10.

_metadata.default_rule: If no curve data (VETERAN or unknown), use week 10 target (strictest)

curves.NH: New Hire on First Path - only one process, <400h
curves.XT_NH: Cross-Trained New Hire - not veteran anywhere, multiple processes
curves.XT: Cross-Trainee - veteran (>=400h) in another process, doing this one
curves.LAPSED_XT: Lapsed Cross-Trainee - same targets as XT
